messages:
maria: T-20m: final deploy for feature/deck. Need quick ack on owners: smoke / liveness / rollback / db migrations. I can own coordination. Who's on smoke?

alex: I'll do smoke and perf checks. Will run the smoke script and validate p50 < 150ms.

jess: I can own rollback flags and config toggles. Confirmed my rollback playbook is up-to-date. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll monitor metrics and traces. Alerting runbook linked in #oncall. @alex ping me when you start smoke.

ops-runner: DB migration staged in staging, nothing destructive. Ready to abort/rollback if we see schema issues.

maria: Quick checklist:
```
- Owners: alex (smoke), sam (monitor), jess (rollback), maria (coord)
- Smoke script: ./scripts/smoke-check.sh --env=prod
- Rollback flag: feature.deck.enabled=false (FF toggle)
- DB: migration id 20260318_deck_add_col staged
- Canary window: 5m 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green
- Post-deploy smoke: hit 3 endpoints, verify embeddings latency and generation correctness
```
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have your step ready.

alex: ✅ smoke prep done. smoke script passes locally, will run in prod window. starting dry-run now.

jess: ✅ rollback toggle ready, infra PR #424 created. manual rollback steps in the playbook.

sam: ✅ observability hooks validated, dashboards pinned, alert thresholds set (p50>200ms, error rate>0.5%).

ops-runner: Note: autoscaler bump allowed for 10m post-deploy. Escalation oncall is @oncall-ryan.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria at 3923456880, plan: gradual-canary (1/5/25) - automated smoke run enabled.

maria: T-5m. final rollcall: alex, sam, jess, ops-runner. Any blockers?

alex: none here, starting smoke in 2m.

sam: watching. will call out within 2m if anything.

jess: all clear.

maria: Go for deploy when alex confirms started. I'll ping product and docs after cut.

alex: starting smoke now. logs:
```
$ ./scripts/smoke-check.sh --env=prod
OK: /v1/generate 200
OK: /v1/embeddings 200
Latency p50 120ms
```
Looks good so far.

sam: seeing minor GC spike on replica-2 but p50 stable. continuing watch.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 -> 1% traffic shifted at 3923456900

maria: Canary 1% green. moving to 5% :shipit:

deploy-bot: Canary step 2 -> 5% traffic at 3923456920

sam: 5% stable for 3m, no errors. memory trending normal.

maria: moving to 25% then full. Alex, run post-deploy smoke checklist.

alex: post smoke run:
- /v1/generate sample OK
- /v1/embeddings OK
- latency p50 135ms
- no errors in logs
All good :tada:

jess: Rollback not needed. I'll merge infra PR and document the toggle.

maria: Docs and release notes pinged. Thanks team. I'll close this thread after 10m.

ops-runner: Monitoring for 30m. escalate if error rate increases.
